plan.hypothesis: A single seeded image producer makes consumed training-image order repeatable; it may reduce score variance but costs loading parallelism and changes the combined sampling schedule. Weighted Gaussian sampling remains unseeded.
plan.scope: Experimental source build only; no replacement of the installed engine. Compare identical instrumented engine with many versus one image producer, same photos and training settings.
plan.acceptance: Trace repeatability must be measured separately from model determinism and quality. No production adoption without stable quality and acceptable cost across both scenes.

raw_runs.measurement: adapter training, evaluation and export; excludes SfM and input copy

timing_scope: Adapter training/evaluation/export with the same instrumented local binary; excludes source compilation, SfM and input copy. OS/driver caches not flushed. Image trace is enabled equally in both variants.
quality_scope: Frozen historical shared-camera scenes; every eighth image held out from training but used in SfM. Compare RGB PSNR and Gaussian-window SSIM at long edge 512. Two repeats are exploratory.
decision: Not adopted as default: one producer makes consumed image order repeatable in these runs, but model bytes/counts still differ and mean PSNR decreases in both scenes. This change also alters the mixed sampling schedule; it is not merely less decoding concurrency.

pilot.measurement: adapter training, evaluation and export; excludes SfM and input copy

validation.browser: Loaded baseline and candidate for both scenes at photo 1; dragged each candidate in walk mode; no console warnings/errors. Pipe edges, cables, streaks and missing detail remain.
